text:
Ava: hey team — long shot but my flight's delayed and i won't be able to start the EU primary shift on time tonight (22:00-02:00 UTC). i'm listed as primary but can do a handoff until 20:00 UTC. also FYI it's a EU bank holiday so traffic patterns might be spikier than usual. there's already some elevated queueing on inference workers. can someone pick up primary or shadow? sorry for the late ping :disappointed:
Diego: I can take primary 22:00-02:00 UTC. i'll need someone to cover secondary/overlap from 02:00-06:00. @Priya are you available for 00:00-04:00?
Priya: I can shadow 22:00-00:00 then I have a meeting. I can be secondary 00:00-04:00 if Samir can do 02:00-06:00. not ideal, but workable.
Samir: I can cover 02:00-06:00 as deputy/secondary. i'll handle post-incident cleanup if anything pops. quick question — which runbook should we follow for inference queue surge?
oncall-bot: incident-bot: Active alert group "inference-queue-eu" detected — mean queue length +42% over baseline across eu-inference-prod. Affected customers: ecom-pro, insights.ai. Severity: P2. Suggested runbook: /runbooks/inference-surge (scale pools, enable fallback model, check KV cache).
Ava: thanks. Diego, please annotate PD and mark handoff. quick runbook snippet to scale: ```redwoodctl pools scale --name eu-inference-prod --add 2``` Also check KV cache and model fallback toggles: `/runbooks/inference-surge -> step 2 (enable-fallback)`
Diego: Ack. doing PD handoff now. @oncall-bot can you record the rotation after i post? i'll also create a bridge.
oncall-bot: Handoff recorded. primary: Diego (22:00-02:00 UTC), secondary: Priya (00:00-04:00 UTC), deputy: Samir (02:00-06:00 UTC). Bridge created: #incident-4312345678-bridge. Escalation rule: if p95 latency > 800ms for >5m then escalate to SRE Lead.
Maya: APAC coverage confirmed — i'm primary for APAC tonight and monitoring the region. no overlap issues on my side.
Priya: adding short notes to the bridge — ecom-pro shows retry bursts (likely client-side retry loop). recommend enabling prefix-KV caching for that model and consider switching to quantized fallback if workers hit OOMs.
Samir: i'll add a one-page checklist to the bridge and a quick debugging step list. also flagging that cost will spike if we scale; confirmed tradeoff acceptable given SLA risk.
Jules: support here. i'll draft an interim customer note: "We're investigating increased inference latency in EU; routing and capacity changes in progress." i'll post if we're still degraded at 30m. @Diego ping me when scale command completes.
Diego: running scale now: ```redwoodctl pools scale --name eu-inference-prod --add 2``` job id job-88233. ETA ~3m. monitoring.
oncall-bot: Scale job started: job-88233. Logs: /logs/pools/job-88233. Auto-fallbacks remain enabled.
Ava: appreciate it. i'll be reachable via DMs if you need any context. update thread when handoff is fully done.
Diego: Handoff complete and posted to PD. bridge updated. current p95 ~520ms and queue length is trending down. keeping eyes on ecom-pro retries. closing this thread unless we see re-escalation. :thumbsup:
